headline: CRD-7 shows significantly elevated SAE rate (39.8% vs 14.1% placebo) with hypotension signal; 29% of subjects quarantined for data quality issues.
DERM-404 at 53% enrollment shows higher SAE rate in investigational arm (35.5% vs 18.2%) with significant data quarantine affecting 24 subjects.
SMX-401 shows higher toxicity than Docetaxel with 100% AE rate, 30.4% SAE rate, and notable hepatobiliary signals.
RESP-303 at 53% enrollment shows higher SAE rate in RSP-12 arm (35.5% vs 18.2% placebo) with significant data quarantine.
